description: This file defines an abstract class PHP5Soap that extends SugarSoapService, providing SOAP web service functionality with support for both PHP's native SOAP extension and NuSOAP. It manages WSDL generation, service handling, and registration of methods and types, primarily facilitating SOAP-based interactions in the SuiteCRM environment.

classes.name: PHP5Soap
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base SOAP service implementation supporting both PHP's native SOAP extension and NuSOAP, with methods for service initialization, request serving, WSDL handling, error reporting, and method registration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SOAP service, sets the WSDL URL, disables WSDL cache, and reads raw POST data.

methods.name: setObservers
methods.description: Placeholder method for setting observers; currently does nothing.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Handles incoming SOAP requests, serving WSDL if requested, otherwise processing the SOAP service call.

methods.name: generateSoapServer
methods.description: Creates and configures the PHP SOAP server instance if not already initialized.

methods.name: generateNuSoap
methods.description: Creates and configures the NuSOAP server instance if not already initialized.

methods.name: getWSDLPath
methods.description: Returns the file path for cached WSDL, generating and caching it if requested.

methods.name: getNameSpace
methods.description: Returns the namespace URL used for the SOAP service.

methods.name: setSoapVersion
methods.description: Sets the SOAP version used by the server ('1.1' or '1.2').

methods.name: error
methods.description: Sends a SOAP fault with details from an error object.

methods.name: registerImplClass
methods.description: Registers the implementation class for the SOAP service.

methods.name: registerClass
methods.description: Registers a class for WSDL generation and handling.

methods.name: registerType
methods.description: Registers a complex type for WSDL with specified parameters.

methods.name: registerFunction
methods.description: Registers a function for exposure via SOAP.
